evidence.t: Mule deer winter range u-1-013 unit 25 (official), 380 m SE. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2014 (12 years old), right here.
Habitat zone Coastal Western Hemlock (CWHvm1): coast forest, where black tailed deer are among the most common large mammals (95%) and use logged ground often (80%) (lesson: Wet forests).
W facing slope, 17 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Private fields 520 m NE: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Route crosses private land (ParcelMap BC, updated 2026-10-09): get permission first or go around.

seasonRows.notes: On Denman and Hornby Islands the season is Oct 5 to Dec 10. Part of MU 1-6 (Map A26) is 2 point or better; keep antlers with the species licence

Bow Only. no bow only season on the Gulf Islands in MU 1-1 (except Gabriola Island), in zone B of MU 1-5 (Map A12) or on Denman and Hornby Islands (MU 1-6). Part of MU 1-6 (Map A26) is 2 point or better
LEH (Limited Entry Hunting): draw only, not a general open season

plan: Drive: from District of North Cowichan, about 97 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.03769, -124.66612, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 560 m SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 10 m, about 12 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2014 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-7, Region 1. Season: mule deer bucks Sept 10 to Dec 10 and more rows (synopsis page 21, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R1B-deer-walk-0006.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 1-7: about 4,458 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.76 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.6 km and about 10 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
